First release of the design system: tokens, motion, ui and the runifly, nostr and exosquare themes at 0.1.0. patterns is still a 0.0.0 stub.

Badge takes a `tone` prop (neutral, accent, success, warning, danger or info; default neutral). Each tone is a `--color-status-{tone}-fg` and `--color-status-{tone}-bg` pair, and `@macro88/tokens` exports the list as `statusTones`. Apps map their own status words to these tones.

These packages are not on npm. Install the tarballs attached below by URL, and add a pnpm override for every @macro88 package so pnpm doesn't look for them on npm. INSTALL.md has the full setup: the package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml entries, the stylesheet imports, the Tailwind @source line, and the data-theme and data-scheme attributes. Checksums for every tarball are in SHA256SUMS.

The Nostr theme ships the purple palette. The runifly and exosquare themes are temporary placeholder palettes for now.
